title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused | TechCrunch
summary: Nat Friedman, head of product at Meta’s Superintelligence Labs, said in a post on X that the company built a gadget called Muse Home Link. Friedman said Home Link would be ready to ship a few weeks.
